headline: Personality Bonus
title: Homeland Personality Bonus | Twenty Percent Faster Work | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Here is a Homeland trick that is easy to miss. Every facility lists a recommended personality, and an Aniimo that matches it works twenty percent faster there. There are eight personalities, built from four letter pairs. For example, Playful suits the Mine, and Tenacious suits the Carousel Mill. Level four workers are rare, so this bonus is an easy upgrade. Check each worker's personality before you assign it. Which facility needs help? Comment below!
